mods.name: Multi Village Selector
mods.description: Brings village variety to your world by intelligently replacing vanilla village spawns with villages from multiple mods. Features biome-aware selection, weighted pools, wildcard patterns, and configurable village density per biome. Works with CTOV, Towns & Towers, BCA, Terralith, and any mod using vanilla jigsaw structures.

releases.notes:
## What's New

### Apply your generated config from chat
`/mvs generate` now ends with an **[Apply changes now]** button, so you no longer have to find the file and copy it by hand.

1. `/mvs generate` writes the config to `local/mvs/multivillageselector.json5` and shows the button.
2. Clicking it runs `/mvs generate do-confirm`, which warns you to review the list first (it is a best guess and can be wrong) and offers **[Confirm, move now]**.
3. That runs `/mvs generate apply`, which moves the file into `config/`. If the generated file isn't there, it tells you.

If your existing config is still the untouched default MVS created, it is simply replaced. If it has your own changes, it is saved first as `multivillageselector.json5.bak` (only the latest backup is kept). Restart Minecraft afterwards. Copying the file yourself still works.

### Under the hood
- Mappings are now Mojang + Parchment.
- Gradle build migrated to the Kotlin DSL; NeoForge entry point moved to its own package.
- JaCoCo coverage report for the common module, with a regression floor enforced in `check`.
- CI: Gradle wrapper validation, Gradle caching via `setup-gradle`, concurrency control, coverage report artifact.
- Docs updated for the new flow.

No config format changes. Drop-in upgrade from 0.4.2.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rhettl/multi-village-selector/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

releases.notes:
## v0.4.0 Release Notes

### 🎮 Placement Control

MVS now controls village spacing directly - no more datapacks needed!

```json5
placement: {
  "minecraft:villages": {
    spacing: 34,      // Grid cell size in chunks
    separation: 8,    // Buffer zone on edges
    spreadType: "triangular",  // linear, triangular, gaussian, etc.
  }
}
```

Use `/mvs info` to see current placement values and their sources.

### 🔍 Locate Command

Find structures with `/mvs locate <structure>`:
- Autocomplete for all pool structures
- Click coordinates to teleport
- Use `/mvs locate <structure> more` for multiple results

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Spawn chunk fix:** Villages now correctly spawn near world origin
- **Biome sampling:** Fixed position mismatch causing wrong biome detection
- **Large structures:** Added `relaxed_biome_validation: true` option for mods with large villages (BCA, CTOV large, etc.)

### ✨ Quality of Life

- `/mvs help` - now paginated with clickable navigation
- `/mvs config fill-placements` - auto-fill placement config with registry values
- `/mvs structure nearby` - structure IDs are now click-to-copy
- Config auto-migrates from v0.3.x (adds `placement{}` section)

### 🔧 Compatibility

- Tested compatible with **C2ME** (concurrent chunk generation)
- Tested compatible with **Explorer's Compass** (structure locations match `/mvs locate`)

### 📖 Documentation

- New [Spread Types Guide](https://github.com/RhettL/multi-village-selector/blob/master/docs/SpreadTypes.md) with visual diagrams
- Rewritten [Spacing Guide](https://github.com/RhettL/multi-village-selector/blob/master/docs/SpacingGuide.md) for v0.4.0
- Updated all docs for new placement config format

releases.notes:
## Multi Village Selector v0.4.0-RC1

**Release Candidate** - Testing feedback welcome!

### Overview

v0.4.0 adds placement control, a locate command, and fixes critical spawn chunk issues. This release gives you full control over village spawn density and location prediction.

### New Features

- **`/mvs locate <structure> [more]`** - Find nearest structures with clickable teleport links
- **Placement control** - Configure `spacing`, `separation`, `salt`, and `spreadType` in config (overrides mods like Better Village that modify placement)
- **`relaxed_biome_validation`** - Bypass vanilla's strict biome checks for large mod structures (BCA, etc.)
- **Config migration** - Automatically upgrades v0.3.x configs to v0.4.0 format

### Bug Fixes

- **Spawn chunk race condition** - Villages now spawn correctly at world spawn (structure discovery moved to SERVER_BEFORE_START)
- **Fabric biome override** - Fixed proxy method matching for cross-platform compatibility
- **Config migration** - Fixed comma handling when adding new properties

### Known Issues

- Large structures (terralith:fortified_village) may fail terrain validation on hilly biomes - this is vanilla behavior, not MVS

### Next Steps

- [ ] Fabric testing
- [ ] Documentation review
- [ ] Full changelog with v0.4.0 stable release
